title: Constitutional AI self-critique loop
summary: Constitutional AI coordinates capability with human values through a constitutional framework: the model critiques and revises its own responses against the principles (RLAIF), so the critique signal shrinks as responses align. Capability and alignment grow together instead of trading off.
source: Ch03 — Dario Amodei: "capability, human values, and the constitutional framework that coordinates them"

nodes.label: Human Values
nodes.description: What the model should do: helpful, harmless, honest

nodes.label: Constitutional Framework
nodes.description: Principles that coordinate capability with values

nodes.label: Critique Signal
nodes.description: Gap between a response and the principles (RLAIF)

nodes.label: Aligned Response
nodes.description: Response revised until it fits the principles

edges.description: A more capable model produces better responses
Values are written into the constitution
The framework defines what the model critiques against
The more aligned the response, the smaller the critique signal
The critique drives revision of the response

identifiability_note: The constitution is itself a design choice confounded with the values it encodes; the effect of the framework on alignment is not separable from those values.
